task: Evidence Dossier v0.2 — second inspectable source on stochastic acid generation in EUV photoresist
stopCondition: Close with a documented negative result rather than add a metadata-only source.

databases.name: OSTI (US DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information) records API
queries: EUV lithography photon shot noise stochastic model photoresist
extreme ultraviolet resist acid generation secondary electron stochastic simulation
line edge roughness stochastic EUV resist model Naulleau
databases.result: Returned DOE-funded records with fulltext links. Most hits were resist chemistry and materials rather than stochastic modelling.

databases.name: arXiv API
databases.result: Returned zero entries for all queries in this session. Treated as an access failure of the query interface, not as evidence that no such preprints exist.

databases.name: Crossref REST API
databases.result: Used to confirm identifiers rather than to discover full text.

databases.name: MDPI publisher site
databases.result: HTTP 403 to automated retrieval. Remains metadata-verified only in the dossier and supports no substantive claim.

candidatesConsidered.title: Comparison of the spatial statistics of random and defined-sequence photoresist films
candidatesConsidered.reason: Directly downloadable accepted manuscript under CC-BY 4.0; addresses photoacid generator placement, shot noise and the RLS tradeoff; inspected and quoted with exact locators.

candidatesConsidered.title: Characterization of latent image of electron beam resist via CD-RSoXS
candidatesConsidered.reason: Electron-beam resist metrology rather than EUV stochastic acid generation. Different exposure mechanism; not meaningfully comparable to the existing source.

candidatesConsidered.title: Various EUV resist materials and vapour-phase infiltration papers
candidatesConsidered.reason: Resist materials chemistry. None models stochastic acid generation, so none would compare against the existing modelling source on any shared axis.

candidatesConsidered.title: Spectral Analysis of Line Edge and Line Width Roughness using Wavelets
candidatesConsidered.reason: Roughness signal analysis method rather than acid generation. Would not support a comparison on dimensionality, dose, statistics or material model.

accessFailures: arXiv API returned zero results for all attempted queries.
MDPI returned HTTP 403 to automated retrieval.
OSTI full-text endpoint returned HTTP 202 with an empty body on the first attempt; a retry with a browser user agent returned the PDF.
note: A source was found and inspected, so the negative-result path was not taken. The rejected candidates are recorded because the reasons for rejection are part of the evidence about how narrow the genuinely comparable literature is.
